headline: White House launches voluntary pre-release testing for frontier AI
body: The US administration finalised a voluntary framework under which labs can submit closed frontier models for government safety testing up to 30 days before release; open-weight models are excluded. That strengthens Alignment & Control and Global Coordination, which lifts Gatekeeper and Protector God and pulls Conquerors and Self-Destruction down. Alibaba released Qwen3.8-Max and pledged open weights, spreading capability more widely. Texas froze new data-center approvals pending a grid audit, a sign of Tech Backlash that lifts Reversion, though the exact date of that report is uncertain. Horizon Balance improved to -1.49.
movers_note: Gatekeeper +0.5, Protector God +0.4 and Conquerors -0.3 were driven by the White House testing framework (+0.47, +0.35 and -0.35).
